---
name: "LoopDev: Tracks: Create"
description: "Create a LoopDev specification-driven engineering track using the track governance skill and approved template."
argument-hint: "Track title and intended outcome"
agent: agent
---

Use the `track-governance` skill to create a new LoopDev track. Ask only the questions needed to
define scope, owner, dependencies, risks, initial phase, validation, and closure criteria. Create
the file in `tracks/planned/`, then validate it and regenerate the dashboard.
